notes: COMBO / FULL-CARD OVERLAY (756×1100) — a Dark CHARACTER printed over the Cloud City IMMEDIATE EFFECT All Too Easy (the whole frame changes: blue-grey Episode I-era Dark character frame instead of the red Effect frame). Top to bottom: (1) TITLE BAR: round disc at the left = red/black Darth Maul face (Decipher's Episode I Sith character disc; printed card has the green Effect disc) → affiliation recorded as 'Sith', disc 'sith' — NO existing asset/affiliation value for this disc in the repo (only dark-jedi / jedi-light / republic); please confirm the name and add a disc asset. Title '•Galen, Secret Apprentice'; destiny 1 (printed 5 → base_destiny '5'). (2) LORE BOX: the slip prints '“Perhaps you are not as strong as the Emperor / thought.”' (first line indented, curly double quotes) — same words as the printed lore (which is on one line on the printed card), so lore = printed lore; wiki has straight single quotes ('…'), the 745 scan prints curly double quotes “…” → corrected. Right of the lore box: the Cloud City expansion ring (orange cloud-car sphere), as printed; no Episode I icon. (3) ART WINDOW: SLIP ART — The Force Unleashed promotional art (Galen/Starkiller with a red lightsaber in a ship interior), the same image as the PC's VB4 'Galen Marek, Starkiller' → slip_art true, art.src = slip crop, art.rect [99,353,657,739] measured with numpy just inside the bevel (picture spans y 353–739; left edge slants x≈93 at top → x≈99 at bottom, right edge x≈663 top → x≈657 bottom, so the rect is the largest all-picture box). No copyright line printed on the slip (stays: Cloud City 1997, Hoth-style line). (4) Stat boxes POWER 6 / ABILITY 5 / FORCE-SENSITIVE (label only; no banner, as for characters); deploy 5 / forfeit 7; game text 5 lines; icon column: one light-blue box with a dark blaster rifle = Episode I-era Warrior icon → ['warrior']; then the diamond-17 set mark (not an icon). (5) Bottom strip: caption '•All Too Easy (V)', number 13. CHANGES vs printed All Too Easy (CC, Immediate Effect, destiny 5): card type Immediate Effect → Character, frame, disc, title, destiny 5 → 1, art, stats/deploy/forfeit/icon added, game text replaced (printed: 'If an opponent’s character at the Carbonite Chamber was just ‘hit’ by a lightsaber, deploy on that character. Character is instead immediately captured and ‘frozen.’ If captive released, lose Immediate Effect. (Immune to Control.)'); lore and CC ring unchanged. Slip text matches the stub (stub straight apostrophe). Base scans: CC-D-alltooeasy.gif (745) — its game text reads 'is about to be ‘hit’' where the archive face reads 'was just ‘hit’', so it may be an errata face: used for art only; CC-D-alltooeasy-decipher-archive.gif (350) also downloaded.
